WHAT YOU ALREADY KNOW   What you already know
Chapter 11 split the master-budget variance into a sales-volume and a flexible-budget variance. Chapter 12 split an input variance into price and efficiency. This chapter splits each of those parts once more.

WORKED EXAMPLE   Worked example: the mix and quantity variances
In the budgeted mix, the actual 180,000 units would have included 108,000 of the small jars, not 117,000. Applying each product's budgeted margin gives a mix variance of $4,500 unfavorable. The quantity variance is (180,000 − 200,000) × $1.80 = $36,000 unfavorable. Figure F313-05 sets out both.

EXAM TRAP   Mix uses the actual total
The sales-mix variance is always calculated on the actual total units. Using the budgeted total turns it into a different variance and the two parts will not add to the sales-volume variance.

WORKED EXAMPLE   Worked example: the halva blend
18,000 packs allow 9,000 kg in a 60% to 40% blend; the plant used 9,200 kg. Mix: $420 unfavorable, because more of the dearer paste was used. Yield: (9,200 − 9,000) × $1.90 = $380 unfavorable. Figure F313-08 sets out the calculation.

YOUR TURN   The sugar line
Complete the blank cells of Figure F313-09. Answers are at the end of the chapter.

EXAM TRAP   Yield is valued at the average
The yield variance is valued at the weighted-average standard price of the blend, $1.90 a kilogram here, not at the price of one input.

WORKED EXAMPLE   Worked example: Levant Distribution
Levant made 2,400 deliveries, allowing 1,200 hours at $10.00; it worked 1,260 hours at $10.40. The overhead spending variance compares actual variable overhead with the standard rate applied to the hours worked. Figure F313-10 shows all four variances.
Wage paid to drivers and warehouse staff
Hours per delivery or per order
Same formula: (AH − SH allowed) × standard rate
Actual overhead − standard rate × actual hours
Share of senior and junior staff, or of service types
Same formula as a materials or sales mix
There is no usage variance for stock, but input variances remain
